intro: Message eligible registered members and keep a dated conversation on the website.
oversight_notice: Authorized Admins can review conversations through audited access. In native conversations, they may post as themselves when current permissions allow.
channels_notice: This Inbox stores website messages and manual records. It does not sync email, Gmail, WhatsApp, SMS or telephone calls.
conversations_help: Your currently authorized conversations and unread counts. Opening history does not mark it read.
oversight_help: This list contains conversation metadata. Open an audited review to read a transcript.
routing_help: Buyers can contact their current assigned eligible agent or an Admin. Other members can find eligible people who allow member messaging. Service-request conversations remain in the service workspace.
find_member: Search by member name or member number
empty_recipients: No eligible members match this search. Current assignments, discovery preferences and blocks apply.
open_help: Open or resume this conversation, then post an entry when you are ready.
empty_conversations: No conversations are available in this view.
visibility_help: Choose whether eligible registered members can find you in Inbox. This choice does not publish your profile, contact details or property projects. Buyer routing and blocks still apply.
allow_discovery: Allow eligible members to find me in Inbox
default_visibility: Until you save an Inbox choice, discovery follows your member-profile visibility.
settings_changed: Your preferences changed elsewhere. Review the current version before saving this draft.
block_help: Blocking prevents new conversations and further entries in either direction while retaining authorized history. Community blocks and the other person's blocks are separate; removing your Inbox block does not override them.
legacy_help: Authorized Admins can open audited, read-only reviews of awarded-work and negotiation transcripts. This does not grant access to the underlying property or project.
empty_legacy: No recorded service conversations are available.
audit_help: Opening a review records your own Admin identity and purpose. Access expires after ten minutes. Legacy service histories remain read-only.
review_expired: Review access has expired. Open a fresh audited review to continue. Retained history is unchanged.
two_participants: Two primary participants; Admin interventions identify the recording Admin.
assignment_history: Buyer history stays with that buyer. A changed agent assignment may close the former agent's access; the new agent does not automatically receive old direct messages.
legacy_read_only: This is an audited, read-only service transcript.
occurred_local: Reported time in this browser's local time zone
manual_record_notice: This is the author's manual record, visible to authorized conversation readers. It does not send a WhatsApp message or place a call, and does not verify delivery, a completed call or a counterparty reply.
manual_confirm: I understand this records my report and is visible to authorized conversation readers.
body_limit: {{count}} / 2,000 Unicode characters. Use plain text; line breaks and tabs are allowed.
stale: This view may be out of date. Refresh before posting another entry.
read_error: Inbox could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
access_lost: This Inbox resource is no longer available to your current account. Its private content has been hidden.
rate_limit: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then refresh.
invalid_fields: Check the entry fields, length and reported date/time before continuing.
saved: Action recorded. Current authorized data has been reloaded.
uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Your original attempt is kept in this tab. Check its result before trying again.
checked_unknown: No authorized receipt was found. Current access was checked again. Any retry uses the original action and text.
unread_summary: Conversations with unread entries: {{conversations}}. Unread entries: {{entries}}.

delivery.stored_in_app: Stored on the website; no external delivery is claimed.
delivery.manual_record: Manual record; external delivery is not verified.

reasons.blocked: A block makes this conversation read-only. Authorized history is retained.
reasons.assignment_changed: The buyer's agent assignment changed. This history is read-only.
reasons.participant_unavailable: A participant is currently unavailable. Posting is disabled.
reasons.buyer_relationship_required: Current buyer-to-agent permissions do not allow new entries.
reasons.review_required: Open your own audited Admin review before reading this transcript.
reasons.legacy_read_only: Legacy service transcripts are read-only in Admin review.

errors.error_access: Current access is no longer available. Private content has been hidden.
errors.error_conflict: The action conflicts with current state. Check its result and review current access before continuing.
errors.error_fields: The server could not accept these fields. Check the result, then review the current state.
errors.error_unknown: The result is not confirmed. Keep this tab open and check this attempt's result.
errors.error_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Keep the original attempt and check its result before trying again.
errors.error_rate: Too many requests. Wait before checking again.
